title: GradeThread Grade Field
description: The GradeThread Standard v1.0 — an open, versioned specification for the machine-readable GradeThread condition grade field. Attach this to a listing, Product, or Offer so the grade is comparable and citable the way card listings cite a PSA grade. This describes the open standard only; it makes no claim that any third party has adopted it. Spec: https://gradethread.com/grading-standard. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

standard.description: Fixed discriminator identifying the GradeThread Standard.

version.description: Spec version. Bumped only on a breaking change to this shape.

grade.description: The overall condition grade on the GradeThread 1.0–10.0 scale, in half-point increments.

scaleMin.description: Lowest possible grade on the scale.

scaleMax.description: Highest possible grade on the scale.

tier.description: Named tier the grade maps to (NWT, NWOT, Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair, Poor).

certUrl.description: Public certificate URL a buyer can open to verify the grade.

spec.description: Canonical URL of the published specification.
